articles.subject: Signing in, forgot password and choosing your password
articles.html:
Your client area is where you follow everything we do together: invoices, estimates, proposals, contracts, projects, tasks, ideas, requests and support.

Signing in

Open the client area address we sent you, enter your Email and your Password, then press Sign in. The button is active once both fields are filled. You stay signed in on that browser for 14 days.

If the sign-in fails you will see "Wrong email or password". After several wrong attempts the sign-in is locked for a few minutes ("Too many attempts"). If you see "Your company account is not active", please contact us.

Your first password

Use the link in the invitation email: it opens Choose your password. Type a password of at least 8 characters, repeat it in Confirm password and press Save and sign in. An invitation link is valid for 7 days and works once.

Forgot your password?

On the sign-in page press Forgot password, enter your email and press Send reset link. If an account exists for that address, a link arrives by email. It is valid for one hour and works once. You can ask for it up to 3 times an hour. Press Choose a new password in the email, type it twice and press Change password: you are signed in and taken to your overview. Changing a password signs you out of your other browsers.

The link does not work

If you see "Link expired", press Get a new link. Links expire for your safety.

articles.subject: Finding your way: the menu and the header icons
articles.html:
The top bar is the same on every page.

The menu

The pills show the areas open to you: Overview, Invoices, Estimates, Proposals, Contracts, Projects, Tasks, Ideas, Requests, Support and Help center. We can switch some of them off for your company, so you may not see all of them. Tasks appears together with Projects.

The icons on the right

  • Calendar: "Book a meeting" opens our booking page to choose a time with the team.
  • Flag: changes the language (English, Français, Español, 日本語, العربية). Arabic switches the page to right-to-left. Your choice is remembered on your account.
  • Moon / sun: switches between the light and the dark look.
  • Your picture: opens My profile, Install the app and Sign out.

The chat bubble

The round button at the bottom right opens a chat with our team on every page.

The browser tab shows the page you are on and our company name, which helps when you have several tabs open.

articles.subject: Your overview at a glance
articles.html:
The Overview is the first page after you sign in. It answers: what do I owe, and what is waiting for me?

The three tiles

  • To pay: the amount still owed, with a red badge when part of it is overdue (or "Nothing overdue").
  • Paid: what you have paid, with the percentage of what was invoiced.
  • Projects in progress, or the number of open requests.

Waiting for you

This card appears only when something needs you: an overdue or unpaid invoice, an estimate or a proposal to answer, a contract to sign. Press a row to open the document.

Your card and your details

On the left you see your picture with a ring: the percentage is the share of what was invoiced that is paid. New request takes you to Support, Email and Call use the details we have for you. Detailed information shows your company details; Edit opens your profile.

Interaction history

Your latest invoices, estimates, proposals and contracts as tiles. Filter them with All, Waiting or Done. A tile opens the document in a new tab.

Payments, projects, support

Three cards sum up your payments (invoiced, paid, to pay), your projects with their progress and your last support requests, each with a link to the full page.

articles.subject: Invoices: reading, downloading and paying
articles.html:
Open Invoices in the menu to see all your invoices. Draft invoices are never shown.

The list

Each row shows the number, the date, the due date (in red when late), the total, the amount left To pay and the status: Unpaid, Partially paid, Overdue, Paid or Cancelled. Use To pay at the top to see only what is still due.

Open, print and download

  • Open (or the number) shows the invoice in a new tab. There you can Print it or press Download PDF.
  • PDF in the list downloads it straight away.

How to pay

You do not pay inside the client area. While an invoice is unpaid, its page shows Payment details and our bank details: pay by bank transfer or by the method described there, and quote the invoice number. When we record your payment the invoice becomes Paid, and the page lists it under Payments received.

Good to know

Recurring invoices are created automatically by us and appear in the list like any other invoice. You can choose which invoice emails you receive in My profile.

articles.subject: Estimates: accept or refuse
articles.html:
An estimate is our price offer. It appears in Estimates once we have sent it.

The list

You see the number, date, Valid until, total and status (Sent, Accepted, Declined or Expired). Use Waiting for me to see the estimates that need your answer. Open shows it in a new tab, PDF downloads it.

Accepting

  1. Open the estimate and press Accept.
  2. Check your first name, last name and email.
  3. Draw your signature in Sign here (use Clear to start again).
  4. Press Accept estimate.

A banner then says who accepted and when, and our team is informed.

Refusing or asking a question

Press Refuse, add a reason if you wish (optional) and confirm with Refuse estimate. To ask something first, write a comment at the bottom of the page. An estimate past its date shows "This estimate has expired": contact us and we will send a new one.

The document pages are shown in the language of our documents (French or English), whatever language you chose for the client area.

articles.subject: Proposals: accept or refuse
articles.html:
A proposal describes the work we suggest. It appears in Proposals when we send it.

The list

Each row shows the proposal (number and subject), the date, Open until, the total and the status: Open, Sent, Revised, Accepted or Declined. Revised means we changed it and need your answer again. Use Waiting for me to see those that need you.

Answering

  • Accept: confirm your name and email, sign with your finger or mouse and press Accept proposal.
  • Refuse: add an optional reason and press Refuse proposal.
  • Download PDF keeps a copy.

You can answer only while the proposal is Open, Sent or Revised. A proposal past its date shows "This proposal has expired".

Questions

If comments are open on the proposal you can write at the bottom of the page. Otherwise it says "Comments are turned off for this proposal": use Support or the chat instead.

articles.subject: Contracts: sign on screen
articles.html:
Contracts you must read and sign appear in Contracts.

The list

Each row shows the contract (with its type), the date, Ends ("No end" when it has no end date), the value and the status: To sign, Signed or Expired. Use Waiting for me to see those to sign.

Signing

  1. Press Open and read the contract.
  2. Press Sign contract.
  3. Check your first name, last name and email.
  4. Draw your signature (it is always required) and press Sign contract.

The page then shows "Contract signed" with your name, the date and time. We are informed by email. Press Download PDF to keep a signed copy.

Good to know

There is no refuse button on a contract: if something is not right, write a comment at the bottom of the page or contact us. A contract that has ended and was not signed shows "This contract has ended".

articles.subject: Writing a comment on an estimate, proposal or contract
articles.html:
At the bottom of an estimate, a proposal (when comments are allowed) or a contract you find Comments.

Writing

Enter Your name, write in the box ("Write a comment…") and press Send. Our team is told and answers there; their answers are tagged Team.

Reading

Recent comments are shown first. Comments older than a few days fold into Older comments: press it to open them.

Good to know

  • You can send up to 5 comments per minute.
  • Comments are about that document. For anything else use Support or the chat.
  • Invoices have no comment box: ask us through Support.

articles.subject: Following your projects
articles.html:
Projects shows the work we do for you.

The list

Each card shows the project name, its status (Not started, In progress, On hold, Finished or Cancelled), the dates, a progress bar and the number of tasks done. Progress counts the tasks we share with you; a finished project shows 100%.

A project's page

  • About this project: what it is.
  • Schedule: start, due date and completion.
  • Milestones: the key steps with their dates, when we have defined some.
  • Tasks shared with you: press a task to open it.
  • Files: the files we made visible to you.

The project page is for reading: to talk to us about the work, use a task's conversation, Requests or Support. If you do not see Projects in the menu, it is not open for your company.

articles.subject: Tasks shared with you: messages and files
articles.html:
Tasks lists the tasks we chose to share with you.

The list

Use Open (the default), Done or All. A row shows the task, its project, status, due date, progress and the number of messages. Press the task name to open it.

A task's page

  • About this task and the Schedule: dates, priority (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) and Our team, the people in charge.
  • Files: press a file to open it. Press Add files to send us up to 8 files at once: they are marked "Sent by you" and we are told.
  • Conversation: write in "Write a message to our team" and press Send. Use Reply under a message to answer it.

Good to know

You see only the messages we sent to you and yours. You cannot edit or delete a message once sent, so read it before pressing Send.

articles.subject: Ideas: approve, show interest or decline
articles.html:
In Ideas we propose things that can help your business grow or save money.

The list

Each card shows the category (Grow the business, Save money, Marketing…), the status, the title and what you gain, with Impact and Effort and the price. A new idea shows the date by which we would like your answer.

An idea's page

  • The idea: the full text and the sources.
  • At a glance: what you gain, impact, effort, estimated price and answer date.
  • Our offer: when we prepared one, the lines, options and totals (paid once, per month, first year, whole contract).

Answering

Choose Approve, I am interested or Not now. You can type a message in the box first: it is sent with your answer. To ask a question without answering press Send a message. You can still change your answer until we start working on the idea; after that the buttons disappear.

Under your own messages you can Reply, Edit or Delete.

articles.subject: Requests: report an error or ask for a change
articles.html:
Requests is where you report a bug, ask for a change or a code integration, or ask a question. You follow each request until it is solved. It is different from Support: use Requests for work on your website or product.

Sending a request

  1. Press New request.
  2. Choose the Kind of request: Error or bug, Code integration, Change or improvement, Question or Other.
  3. Write a Title (required) and the details: steps to reproduce, what you expected, what to integrate.
  4. Add the page address if it concerns a page, choose How urgent is it? and attach screenshots or files (up to 10).
  5. Press Send the request.

Following it

Each request has a code (for example REQ-12) and a status: New, Under review, Planned, In progress, Testing, Waiting for you, Done or Declined. When it is Waiting for you, an orange notice appears on the list: answer in the Follow-up and it goes back to Under review.

If a request is Done or Declined but the problem is still there, press It is not solved: reopen.

articles.subject: Contacting support: opening a request
articles.html:
Support is for questions and problems. We answer in the client area and by email.

Opening a request

  1. Press New request.
  2. Write the Subject (required) and choose a Department if you know it.
  3. Choose the Priority.
  4. Describe what you need or what went wrong in Message (required).
  5. Add screenshots or files: paste with Ctrl+V, drop them in the box, attach them, or use Capture the screen. Up to 10 files per message.
  6. Press Send request.

The request opens with the status Open and you get a confirmation. Our answer arrives in the request and by email.

Tips

  • One subject per request makes answers faster.
  • A screenshot of the problem often saves a question.

articles.subject: Following a support request, closing it and rating us
articles.html:
The Support page lists all your requests.

Finding a request

The three counters (Open requests, Waiting for you, Closed) and the tabs filter the list. Use Search a request for a number, subject or department. A bold subject with a new reply badge means we answered and you have not read it yet.

Inside a request

You see the whole conversation, your messages on the right and ours on the left. Pictures open larger when you press them. In Details you find the dates, who handles it, the department, the priority and the project, and in Files every attachment.

Write in Reply and press Send reply. Replying always reopens the request.

Closing and rating

When your question is solved press Close this request. You can then give 1 to 5 stars and a comment in How did we do? and press Send my rating. A rating cannot be changed afterwards. If the problem comes back, press Reopen this request or reply to it.

articles.subject: Chatting with our team
articles.html:
The round chat button at the bottom right is on every page.

Starting

Press the bubble. A green dot means someone from the team is online; the header shows who is available. If nobody is online you can still leave a message and we reply when we are back. A red number on the bubble counts the replies you have not read.

What you can send

  • Text (up to 2000 characters): write in "Write a message…" and send.
  • Files and pictures, a pasted picture or a screen capture.
  • Voice messages: press the microphone, allow the browser to use it, record and press Send voice message (Cancel to drop it).
  • A reply to one message: use the reply action, the box shows "Replying to …".

If we turned calls on you also see a Voice call phone icon in the header.

Chat or support?

The chat is quick and informal and keeps one private conversation with you. For anything that needs follow-up or an owner, open a support request.

articles.subject: Using the help center
articles.html:
The Help center holds guides and answers, like this one.

Finding an article

  • Type in "Type to search an article" and press Enter.
  • Or open a Topic card to see its articles. Most read lists the favourites.
  • Each result shows the title, the reading time and the topic. All topics takes you back.

Reading

An article has the title, the topic, the update date and, on the right, In this page (jump to a section) and More in this group.

Telling us if it helped

At the end, answer Was this article helpful? with Yes or No. If the answer is No, press Open a support request and we will help you. You can vote once a day per article.

You only see articles in your own language.

articles.subject: Booking a meeting with the team
articles.html:
You can book a time with us at any moment.

How to book

  1. Press the calendar icon at the top right ("Book a meeting"). Our booking page opens in a new tab.
  2. Choose a day and a free time. Only the times we offer are shown.
  3. Fill in your details and what the meeting is about, then confirm.

After booking

We confirm the request and email you the link of the video room. Open the link at the time of the meeting: you may wait a moment until we let you in.

Good to know

  • The days and hours we offer follow our own schedule; bookings need a short notice.
  • To change or cancel, reply to the confirmation email or write to us in Support.

articles.subject: Your details and your password
articles.html:
Open My profile from your picture at the top right.

Your details

Change your First name, Last name, Phone and Position, then press Save changes. The Email is read-only: it is your sign-in. To change it, ask us.

Changing your password

In Password enter your current password, then the new one (at least 8 characters) twice, and press Change password. You stay signed in on this browser; other browsers are signed out.

What you can see

The card What you can see lists the sections open to you, and greys out those that are not. If one is missing, ask us.

Signing out

Use Sign out in the menu of your picture, especially on a shared computer.

articles.subject: Choosing the emails you receive
articles.html:
You decide which emails we send you.

Where

Open My profile and find Email notifications. Each switch is saved the moment you change it.

The switches

  • Invoices: sent, due, overdue, and payment receipts.
  • Estimates: when one is sent or needs your answer.
  • Proposals: when one is sent or about to expire.
  • Credit notes: when one is issued.
  • Contracts: when one needs your signature or is signed.
  • Projects and Tasks: updates.
  • Support: replies to your requests.
  • Ideas: a new idea or an answer on one.
  • Requests: updates and messages on your requests.

Good to know

Everything stays available in the client area even if an email is off. Your company may have switched off a whole kind of email: then none reaches you whatever you choose here. Each person of your company chooses for themselves.

articles.subject: Other ways to be notified: WhatsApp, Telegram and phone notifications
articles.html:
Besides email you can receive the same notification on other channels.

Choosing the channels

In My profile, How do you want to be notified? lets you pick one or several. Each is saved as soon as you change it.

  • Email: the address of your account.
  • WhatsApp: enter your number with the country code (for example +212 6 12 34 56 78), then switch it on. The switch works once a number is entered.
  • Telegram: enter your Telegram chat id (a number of 4 to 20 digits), then switch it on.

Notifications on your phone screen

These are turned on in Install the app (see the article about the phone app). They need no number.

Good to know

The channels you pick receive the same notification: you can combine them. Turn a channel off any time with its switch.

articles.subject: Installing the app on your phone
articles.html:
Open the client area from your home screen like an app, and get notifications on your phone.

Open the dialog

Press your picture at the top right, then Install the app.

Step 1: add it to your phone

  • Chrome, Edge or Android: press Install the app when the button appears.
  • iPhone or iPad: open the page in Safari, press the Share button, choose "Add to Home Screen" then "Add". Open the app from your home screen.
  • Other cases: in the Chrome menu choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"; on a computer use the install icon in the address bar.

Step 2: notifications on the screen

Press Turn on notifications and allow them. The dialog then says the notifications are on for this device. Press Send a test to check. With several devices, remove one with the trash icon, or press Turn off on this device.

If it does not work

  • If notifications are blocked, allow them in your phone or browser settings, then try again.
  • On an iPhone, add the app to the Home Screen first (iOS 16.4 or newer).

articles.subject: Language, dark mode and what is shown to you
articles.html:
You can adapt the client area to you.

Language

Press the flag in the top bar and choose English, Français, Español, 日本語 or العربية. The page reloads in that language; with Arabic the layout reads right to left. Your choice is saved on your account and follows you on other browsers. The first time, we use your account's language, then your company's, then your browser's.

The invoices, estimates, proposals and contracts that open in a new tab are written in our document language (French or English).

Light or dark

The moon or sun icon switches the look. It is remembered on this browser.

Why a section is missing

Sections such as Invoices, Estimates, Projects or Support can be switched off for your company. If you expect one and do not see it, contact us.

Staying private

Sign out on a shared computer and never share your password: we will never ask for it.
